_comment: Jobrela — 'Android with Python', remote, 400 EUR/day, MEDIOR, football fan-engagement platform. Role field is ANDROID DEVELOPER with a Python/FastAPI real-time backend attached. Lapz leads deliberately rather than chronologically: a real-time live-sports fan app running on external live feeds is the closest match in the record, and it carries the native-mobile credibility the Android ask needs. Android sits in the LiveAgent bullets, where it actually happened.
summary: Mobile and backend engineer. I build native mobile apps — Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Coroutines on Android, Swift on Apple platforms — and the Python services behind them, which is what this project needs on both sides. I've owned a real-time live-sports data path end to end: ingesting external live telemetry feeds and building the processing, buffering and playback that drove the visualisation in a Formula 1 companion app for Apple Vision Pro. My day job is architecting the platform behind Slovakia's national e-government, so CI/CD, releases, auth and monitoring are routine rather than someone else's job.

experience.name: Lapz
bullets: Co-founded a real-time Formula 1 companion app for Apple Vision Pro, native in Swift, and owned the entire live-data path: ingesting external live telemetry feeds and building the processing, buffering and playback that drove the spatial visualisation.
Led a small cross-functional team (engineering, 3D, UI/UX) from concept to a shipped product, on a live-sports data source I didn't control.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Six years on a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies, including work on its Android app in Kotlin, alongside the PHP, Java and Python backend and the JavaScript frontend.
Built and consumed the REST APIs between the product's backend and its mobile and web clients, on MariaDB, Redis and ElasticSearch.
Ran the AWS infrastructure with Terraform, including Kubernetes on EKS under Argo CD; two years on the leadership team, mentoring engineers and running hiring.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Architect the platform behind slovensko.sk: Python and Go services, REST API design, PostgreSQL and Oracle data layers, and Kafka messaging for real-time event flows.
Own OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect through Keycloak, secrets in Vault, and the CI/CD pipelines teams ship through — GitLab CI, Argo CD, container builds and automated testing and scanning.

experience.name: ViaJet
bullets: Co-founded and built a B2B2C private-jet charter marketplace end to end: Python and FastAPI backend with async endpoints, PostgreSQL schema design and geospatial search, with a TypeScript frontend.
